name_original: HP - 15.6" Touch-Screen Laptop - AMD A6-Series - 4GB Memory - 500GB Hard Drive - Flyer Red
description_original: HP 15.6" Laptop: With a high-resolution HD touch-screen display and a 500GB hard drive, this laptop offers ample features for portable work sessions and entertainment. The speakers feature DTS Studio Sound for powerful audio, and a Bluetooth interface makes it easy to link mobile devices.
